EmailTemplate.subject: Nacha Update - What you need to know
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
With information circulating about Nacha’s changing regulations, we wanted to take an opportunity to share a bit about what specifically is changing, what you need to know, and how Flywire is responding.
We’ll also go over how you can ensure that other vendors and partners are adhering to these changes.
